pages.title: Transmutation Table
pages.text: The Transmutation Table combines a soul with an ordinary item to create special Raidborn items, essences, and artifacts.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Crafted with Red Carpet, Gold Ingots, and Tuff.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Place an Amethyst Shard in the fuel slot, a soul in the soul slot, and the item to transform in the input slot. Each transmutation consumes one shard and one soul, and takes about 10 seconds.

pages.title: Villager Soul Recipes
pages.text: $(li)Writable Book → Illager Compendium$(li)Goat Horn → Illager Warhorn$(li)Iron Sword → Ominous Dagger$(li)Chest → Raid Bag$(li)Glass Bottle → Raidborn Essence

pages.title: Soul of Many Villagers
pages.text: $(li)Mud → Beast Heart$(li)Bell → Grand Warbell$(li)Glass Bottle → Savage Essence$(li)Artifact Template → Random Artifact

pages.title: Village Soul
pages.text: A Village Soul and a Glass Bottle create an Overlord Essence.$(br2)The transformed item is replaced by the result when the process finishes.
